name: MPL Demo — subroutines, parallel, sequential
description: A tour of MPL in 36 rows, all in D minor over Dm–B♭–F–C at 110 bpm so parts layer. Row 0 plays the whole demo song (sections in SEQUENCE). Rows 1-9 drums, A-D bass (C+D = a SUBROUTINE and its body), E-G pads, H-L leads (trajectory, incrementing and range loops), M-P SEQUENTIAL calls, Q-S PARALLEL launches and nesting, T-Y the sections, Z timing feel. Each row's name says what it is; hover a key for its channel.
prompt: create a whole bank of 36 demonstration sequences: drum and synth patterns, subroutines @, parallel and sequential sequences
